title: Most-requested in RN TradeLab: drawing tools, rebuilt (coming in v0.24)
author: RNAlgotrading

comments.author: Acceptable_You3702
comments.body: Drawing tools are one of those features nobody appreciates until they start fighting the chart every five minutes lol. I'd care most about reliable snapping, easy editing and being able to remove things without messing up the whole layout. I follow price movements on Moon as well and a clean chart workspace makes researching a potential direction much less frustrating.

replies.author: RNAlgotrading
replies.body:
Ha, exactly. You only notice drawing tools when they’re fighting you.

Those three are pretty much what I built around:

* **Snapping:** the Magnet snaps each click to the nearest open, high, low or close of the candle you clicked, so a Fib from swing low to swing high lands exactly on the wicks.
* **Editing:** select a drawing and dots appear on its corners. Drag the dots to reshape it, drag the body to move it, or double-click for exact prices, text and colour.
* **Removing:** right-click a drawing and you get “Delete this…” for just that one, or “Delete all \[type\]” (say, every horizontal line) without touching anything else. Hide/Show clears the view without deleting, and Clear all asks first.

Drawings are anchored to time and price, not screen pixels, so they stay put when you zoom, scroll or switch timeframes.

Curious about snapping: do you prefer it always on, or only when you’re close to a wick (a “weak” magnet)? I’m deciding which to make the default.
